label: D39-fokus-provisioning-aman
decision: Which focus should the next autonomous iteration of Anastrophe build, now that operator lifecycle and card status (ADR-0036/0037) are done and ADR-0038 awaits the user?

candidates.description: Close the credential-minting hole: provisioning (POST /v1/enrollments/{id}/credentials) must prove it comes from the device that started the enrolment, for example with an app-generated provisioning secret whose hash is sent at enrolment, and the unauthenticated challenge must stop being a source of usable instance ids for provisioning. Includes app changes, tests, and an e2e lab check.
FR-60: in-app FAQ screen with per-channel answers in ID and EN, reachable from the Keys tab. App-only.
Fix the verified open backlog items (renewal gaps, presentation overlap, BLE fragment length, flaky test, audit time, invitation and lifecycle minors). No new user-facing feature.
FR-05/FR-10: Release 'Tambah kartu' flow behind protocols with mocked device registration and NFC reading; live wiring waits for accounts, App Attest and a physical iPhone.

evidence_refs: review akhir siklus hidup (declined to judge: penerbitan kredensial lewat id instance, direproduksi 200)
priorities: 1) Security correctness first: close known high-severity holes before adding features (CLAUDE.md rules, SDD tracer note). 2) Not blocked by pending user decisions, hardware, or Apple capabilities. 3) Verifiable end-to-end in the iOS simulator with the local backend. 4) Bounded to one plan of 3–5 tasks on existing modules.
requirements: Removes a known high-severity security gap or implements a currently missing P0 requirement.
Can be verified end-to-end in the iOS simulator with the local backend, without a physical iPhone, reader hardware, an Apple Developer team, or a pending user decision.
Fits in one plan of at most 5 tasks that builds on existing modules.
